item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 16/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense northeast monsoon will bring cool and fine weather to the coastal areas of southern China in the next couple of days. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over the region, and it will be very dry. The monsoon is expected to moderate early to midweek next week. Temperatures will rise gradually over the region. Besides, the area of low pressure near Yap will develop gradually and move towards the vicinity of the Philippines in the next couple of days.

Date/Month: 16/11 (Thursday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy and dry with sunny periods. Temperatures will fall gradually.
Temp range: 18 - 24 C
R.H. range: 45 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
